sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id), CAST(COUNT(T2.person_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.season = 9 AND T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T2.category = 'Cast'

SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.episode_id = (SELECT E.episode_id FROM Episode AS E INNER JOIN Keyword AS K ON E.episode_id = K.episode_id GROUP BY E.episode_id ORDER BY E.votes DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birth_region FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.role = 'assistant location manager'

SELECT COUNT(T1.award_id) FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.episode = 20 AND T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.organization = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND T1.year = 1999 AND T1.result = 'Nominee'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.birth_country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), T1.role FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T2.person_id = T1.person_id INNER JOIN Episode AS T3 ON T3.episode_id = T1.episode_id WHERE T3.episode = 2 AND T1.category = 'Cast'
